scene_type: 2D (top-down view of a wooden gym floor; ball moves in a plane roughly parallel to the image)
units: pixels (full 1920x1080 resolution) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.type: hand-held, looking straight down at the floor (the holder's own shoes are visible at the bottom edge); no pan, slow drift only
camera.per_frame_shift_file: tracks/camera_shift.csv (dx, dy of frame i relative to frame 0, phase correlation on the top band y<260)

drift_summary_px.during_ball_pass_frames_49_72: dx about -5.9 to -6.9, dy about -8.5 to -7.0; < 1 px per frame, negligible versus ball motion (~90 px/frame)

camera.rotation_or_zoom: none detected (top court line tilts ~10 px over 1100 px in every frame: slight camera roll, constant)

objects.name: ball
objects.description: basketball, dark reddish-brown with black seams; the only moving object
objects.motion: enters at the right edge, travels right-to-left across the image along y ~ 430-450, exits at the left edge; image-x decreases monotonically
objects.reference_point: visible centre (cx, cy) = midpoint of the left/right mask edges (x) and of top/bottom edges (y); for edge-cut frames the visible edge -/+ DREF/2

size_px.note: vertical (across-motion) extent is the blur-free diameter; horizontal extent includes ~0-30 px motion blur (241-283 px). bbox height (bbox_y1-bbox_y0) is 251-266 px.

objects.apparent_size_trend: vertical diameter ~258-265 px at frames 52-53, ~250-254 px at frames 56-63, ~256-261 px at frames 64-69: variation within ~+-2-4% (near measurement noise); no clear size change
objects.shadow: a soft grey shadow is attached to the ball: ahead (left) of it until ~frame 59, then behind (right) after ~frame 61 as it passes under the overhead light; tracks/ball_shadow.csv (low reliability)

objects.name: shoes
objects.description: two light blue-grey sneakers (toes) of the person holding the camera, at the bottom edge, cut by the frame

size_px.visible_width_each: ~94 px (x), visible length ~58-65 px (cut by bottom edge)

objects.name: top_maroon_line
objects.description: dark maroon painted court line, horizontal, near the top of the image
objects.position_frame0_px: rows 135-185 at x=300, 144-194 at x=900, 145-194 at x=1400 (slightly tilted)
objects.extent_px: spans the full image width from the left line (x~30) to the right edge

objects.name: right_maroon_line
objects.description: dark maroon vertical court line on the right side
objects.position_frame0_px: columns 1700-1751 (centre x ~1726), from the top line down to the bottom edge

objects.name: left_maroon_line
objects.description: dark maroon vertical court line at the left edge (partly cut by the frame, partly glare)

objects.name: blue_line
objects.description: light-blue vertical court line between the maroon lines

objects.name: light_reflections
objects.description: bright glare spots of ceiling lights on the floor, along y~640 (x ~470, ~1210, ~80)

objects.name: floorboards
objects.description: vertical wooden floorboard strips; spacing about 45-60 px

events.event: shadow of ball appears at right edge
ball first visible (entering at right edge)
ball centre crosses right maroon line (x~1726)
shadow switches from ahead to behind the ball (passes under light)
ball starts leaving at left edge
ball centre crosses left maroon line (x~55)
ball last visible (sliver at left edge)

no_events_detected: no bounce, impact, contact or direction change is visible while the ball is in view; motion is a near-straight right-to-left pass (rolling or very low trajectory)
